Where new business slips today

  • Replies a day late Inquiries sit until someone has a free hour.
  • Every lead looks the same The serious ones wait behind the tire-kickers.
  • The CRM is behind Notes live in inboxes, not where the team can see them.
  • No follow-up Quiet leads are forgotten instead of nudged.

What we build

Built in accounts you own. The agent drafts, checks, or flags; a person makes the call.

  1. Each inquiry read and sorted Web forms, email and messages gathered in one queue, sorted by fit and urgency using rules you set.
  2. A reply drafted A reply in your voice with the right next step: a booking link, a question, or a polite no. A person sends it.
  3. Logged and followed up Every inquiry recorded in your CRM, with follow-up reminders for the ones that go quiet.

Tell us about your version of this

How it starts

  1. 01 A call about one task Tell us the job that eats your week and the tools it touches. We will say plainly whether it is worth building.
  2. 02 Build it in your accounts We set up the data and connections in accounts you own, starting with the tools that task needs.
  3. 03 Run it with a person in charge The agent drafts, checks, or flags. Someone on your team approves anything that matters.
  4. 04 Hand over You get the code, the documentation, and the access. Keep us on for support, or don't.

Built so you are never stuck
